project_scope.note: B004 comparison set. Canonical spelling uses Yucca treculiana; source-pool/older treculeana usage retained in synonym/provenance notes. Current treatment keeps Y. torreyi distinct, with older FNA lumping documented.

shared_traits: evergreen rosettes of stiff or flexible sword-shaped leaves
capsule or fleshy fruit highly useful diagnostically
priority: dry dehiscent capsule versus fleshy indehiscent fruit
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify Y. torreyi versus Y. treculiana from one leaf character alone; older taxonomic lumping and overlap make multi-character confirmation important.

quick_key.if: trunkless colony; broad flexible leaves conspicuously twisted with orange/red wavy-toothed margins
trunkless/short-stemmed colony; very narrow mostly straight leaves with white marginal threads and deeply waist-constricted dry capsule
tree yucca; traditionally marginal threads and often inrolled leaf tips; fleshy fruit
tree yucca; traditionally few/no marginal threads, leaf tips not strongly inrolled; stouter ovary and fleshy fruit
